cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Email Marketing Executive position at your company. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, technical web development, and a keen interest in eCommerce, I am confident in my ability to drive customer engagement and retention through effective email campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, content creation, and website management. I have successfully implemented keyword-targeted content strategies and tracked performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This experience has sharpened my analytical skills and my ability to make data-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance.

My technical background includes front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and WordPress site building with Elementor and Astra. I have a basic understanding of HTML/CSS, which I believe is essential for email template customization. I am comfortable with A/B testing, audience segmentation, and personalization, and I am eager to apply these skills to email marketing.

One of my proudest achievements is my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits. This project taught me the importance of user experience, content relevance, and technical optimization—all crucial for successful email campaigns.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my passion for customer lifecycle marketing with my technical skills. I am a quick learner, highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced environments. I am also committed to maintaining compliance with GDPR and CAN-SPAM regulations.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and enthusiasm can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · Email Marketing · SEO · Content

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
